spans.s:
m. (-धः)
1 Perforation, piercing.
2 Depth, (in measurement.)
E.
व्यध to pierce, aff. अच्.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Sharp, piercing, a piercer or perforator.
m. (-कः)
Camphor.
n. (-कं)
Grain, rice in the ear.
E.
व्यध to pierce, aff. वुन्.

n. (-नं)
1 Piercing, perforation.
2 Depth, (in measurement.)
f. (-नी)
1 An instrument for piercing an elephant's ear.
2 A small gimblet or perforating instrument used to pierce gems, shells, &c.
3 An augre, a gimblet, &c. or any similar instrument.
E.
व्यध to pierce, ल्युट् aff.

f. (-का)
A small-pointed perforating instrument, used especially to make holes in jewels, pearls, shells, &c., an augre, an awl, a gimblet, &c.
E.
कन् added to वेधन as above.

m. (-कः)
Zedoary, (Curcuma zerumbet.)
E.
वेध piercing, (figuratively for pervading as by its odour,) मुख्य principal, कन् added.

A wise or learned man.
4 The sun.
E.
वि before धा to have, Uṇādi aff. असि, and वेध substituted for the root and prefix.

n. (-सं)
The root of the thumb, considered as sacred to BRAHMĀ.
E.
वेधस् BRAHMĀ, and अण् added, the vowel unchanged.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Pierced, perforated.
E.
व्यघ to pierce, aff. क्त.

mfn. (-धी-धिनी-धि)
Piercing, perforating.
f. (-धिनी)
A leech.
E.
व्यघ piercing, णिनि aff.

mfn. (-ध्यः-ध्या-ध्यं)
To be pierced or perforated.
n. (-ध्यं)
A mark, a butt.
E.
व्यघ to pierce, aff. यत्.
